'''Dibbon Mallo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. [[Kaliyo Djannis]] had a [[Reproduction/Legends|fling]] with Dibbon aboard [[Cipher Nine]]'s [[Cipher Nine's X-70B Phantom-class prototype|X-70B ''Phantom''-class prototype]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Dibbon Mallo first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
